key_points: JPMorgan downgraded PEP citing North America weakness and Frito-Lay softness.
Analysts note price cuts earlier this year had limited success and upcoming price hikes may hurt demand.
PepsiCo announced a $1B investment in Colombia expansion, signaling long-term growth focus but near-term execution risk.
Stock is near 52‑week lows; multiple reports show bearish sentiment from DB, TD Cowen, and media commentary.
Some offsetting notes: price cuts showed modest effect and dividend‑growth appeal, but overall outlook remains cautious.
